request.question: Look up revenue for 2193-Q3 and 2193-Q4. Then, in words only, no digits, tell me roughly how much bigger Q3 was than Q4, like 'about two-thirds bigger' or 'nearly double'.

reply:
I looked up revenue for 2193-Q3 and 2193-Q4, all genres. Q3 revenue was about 274,036. Q4 revenue was about 161,525.

In words, the terminal's percent change puts Q3 at about two-thirds bigger than Q4, a little more than that.
